verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence mentions MCP or connecting external MCP servers. The SDK's tool-calling registration only lets a developer register local functions, which is a building block rather than MCP client support. An on-device AI SDK and CLI could plausibly ship MCP client support, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence makes this 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
